description: Na₃SmMn₃(AsO₅)₃ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃/m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.80 Å. Sm is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are three shorter (2.51 Å) and six longer (2.55 Å) Sm-O bond lengths. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.13 Å. As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-65°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.74 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Mn, and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one As atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sm, and two equivalent Mn atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Sm, one Mn, and one As atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaSmMnAs trigonal pyramids.
